notes.title: Game Re-Released on Android.
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

So, I have finally been able to release Save the Creatures on Android again.
This was originally designed for mobile devices so, if you like, head over there and give it a go.

notes.title: Finishing Game Details
notes.notes:
So, a few years ago, I had a company that worked on this game with the idea to release on mobile devices. After financial issues, the company had to be closed with the game not able to be released. 

Recently, a VERY nice person, Zbigniew Staniewicz, helped me to finish the game and make it available to PC users and here we are. I just wanted to give a HUGE thank you for helping me to get to this point. 

Hope you all enjoy!!
